notes.awangaale: Kabaka awangaale! Long live the Kabaka!
notes.bulange: The building where the Lukiiko meets, in Mengo.

guidebook.intro: Buganda is one of the oldest kingdoms in East Africa, and the Kabaka is still at the heart of Ganda identity.

tips.title: Royal titles
body: The king is the **Kabaka**, also called **Ssaabasajja** (chief of men). His wife is the **Nnaabagereka**. The **Katikkiro** (prime minister) leads the Kabaka’s government, and the **Lukiiko** is the kingdom’s parliament, meeting at **Bulange**.

tips.title: Kintu and the beginning
body: In Ganda tradition, **Kintu** was the first Kabaka and the first man, who married **Nnambi**, daughter of the sky. Their story explains how death came into the world, and you will meet it again in the folktales of Unit 40.

culture.title: Kasubi tombs
body: The **Amasiro g’e Kasubi** are the burial grounds of four Kabakas, under a huge thatched house. They are a UNESCO World Heritage Site, rebuilt by hand after a fire in 2010.
